I farm this maize plot like my father did. I have no school, so I do what works and what my neighbors do. Cash is small this year, so I will buy maybe one bag of NPK if the agro-dealer has the subsidy one, and put it small-small at planting. I keep my own seed from last harvest because hybrid seed costs too much and I am not sure of the rain. I put the goat and chicken droppings from my compound on the plot before planting, and I intercrop with cowpea like always so the soil stays good. My wife and I will do most of the work, but at weeding time I will call two or three young men from the village for a few days because the grass grows fast.
